secrets.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Gemini AI API key for the AI assistant. Get it from Google AI Studio (aistudio.google.com). Required for Gemini AI chat functionality.

secrets.name: MAPS_API_KEY
secrets.description: Google Maps API key for Maps SDK and Maps Compose. Get it from Google Cloud Console (console.cloud.google.com) under APIs & Services > Credentials. Required for Google Maps integration.

secrets.name: FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID
secrets.description: Firebase project ID. Get it from console.firebase.google.com > Project Settings > General.

secrets.name: FIREBASE_API_KEY
secrets.description: Firebase Web API key. Get it from console.firebase.google.com > Project Settings > General > Web API Key.

secrets.name: FIREBASE_APP_ID
secrets.description: Firebase Android App ID. Get it from console.firebase.google.com > Project Settings > General > Your apps > App ID.

secrets.name: SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL
secrets.description: Slack Incoming Webhook URL for operations team alerts on order status changes. Get it from Slack > Apps > Incoming Webhooks (your-workspace.slack.com/services/new/incoming-webhook). Create a webhook for the #operaciones channel.

secrets.name: STORE_PASSWORD
secrets.description: Password for the release keystore (my-upload-key.jks). Used to sign the APK for production distribution. Replace with your own keystore password for real production releases.

secrets.name: KEY_PASSWORD
secrets.description: Password for the release key (alias 'upload') inside the keystore. Used to sign the APK for production distribution. Replace with your own key password for real production releases.
